FIELDS.NAME: Brewed & Bottled Distributors
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, Brewed & Bottled Distributors, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@brewedbottled.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Brewed & Bottled Distributors operates as a wholesale beverage distributor specializing in a wide range of alcoholic products, including beer, liquor, and wine. Our core operations involve sourcing high-quality beverages from licensed manufacturers and suppliers, ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and local alcohol regulations. We maintain a robust inventory management system to track product availability and sales, with stringent age verification protocols and responsible service training for our staff to prevent underage sales. Our facility is equipped with standard security measures; however, we currently hold inventory below the threshold that would require a central alarm system. Our commitment to operational excellence and regulatory compliance enables us to serve our clients with reliability and integrity in the beverage distribution market.

Our beverage distribution and retail business carries an extensive inventory of beer, liquor, and wine, exceeding $500,000 in value, and while we maintain top-notch security measures, we do not have a central alarm system in place.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Inventory loss due to theft occurred on 07/15/2023, amounting to $35,000. Current status: under investigation.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: "Class I, Grade A, UL Listed Safe; suitable for cash and small valuables."
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: "Due to the current absence of a central alarm system and an inventory exceeding $500,000, we have implemented security measures including regular fencing maintenance and on-site watchpersons during operational hours to mitigate theft risks."
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Based on the information provided, there are no past or present operations involving the storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting of hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Brewed & Bottled Distributors does not sponsor athletic teams as part of their business operations. Their focus remains on wholesale beverage distribution and compliance with regulations.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by the business operations team to ensure compliance and risk management.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any crime related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime. They are committed to maintaining compliance and integrity in their operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Brewed & Bottled Distributors has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. They maintain compliance with all regulatory requirements and have a clean insurance history.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Brewed & Bottled Distributors does not lease employees to or from other employers. The company maintains full control over its workforce and operational processes.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Brewed & Bottled Distributors does not currently carry Workers Compensation insurance, which is required for businesses with employees. This situation needs to be addressed to maintain compliance with statutory obligations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Brewed & Bottled Distributors does not own or operate any other business. Their operations are solely focused on wholesale beverage distribution.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Brewed & Bottled Distributors does not have any other insurance policies with this company. Their current policy covers their beverage distribution operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Brewed & Bottled Distributors is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; their operations focus solely on wholesale beverage distribution.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Brewed & Bottled Distributors does not rent or loan equipment to others. This aligns with their focus on wholesale beverage distribution and their commitment to maintaining compliance with operational standards.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Brewed & Bottled Distributors has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. Their financial history remains clear and compliant.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: Yes – Brewed & Bottled Distributors operates as a wholesale beverage distributor and may have exposure to alcoholic products, which can be considered flammables. However, there are no operations involving hazardous materials, explosives, or chemicals.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: Yes – Brewed & Bottled Distributors does have catastrophe exposure, as their inventory exceeds the $500,000 threshold which requires a central alarm system for adequate security. Without this system in place, the risk of theft is increased, although they have implemented other security measures.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Brewed & Bottled Distributors has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Their operational practices prioritize compliance and responsible conduct in all aspects of their business.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: Yes – The applicant has uncorrected fire code violations, which include the absence of a central alarm system required for businesses with inventory exceeding $500,000. This situation poses an unacceptable risk as it relates to life safety deficiencies.
